items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: 'cause me and David played for J.K.

ctx.x: Miles had heard of him as, by virtue of the fact that he had traveled with the territory band.

Yeah, that [inaudible] David Newman's. Yeah, David Newman, when David Newman told me that, I said, "David, I didn't think Miles could have possibly known J.K. Miller 'cause me and David played for J.K." He said, "Well, you know a territory man used to come through there, including St. Louis, East St. Louis, wherever Miles was in it." So I wouldn't be … Miles was in love with trumpet as you know, so he had probably heard him. And he was pretty good for Miles to remember him. So um, I'll always remember that moment.
Give us a sense of the musical culture that uh, or the musical scene that you were experiencing in Dallas, in black Dallas.
